skills.name: Competitive Brief
skills.description: Researches named competitors on the web and writes a brief comparing their positioning, messaging and content, with gaps, threats and suggested actions. Can also draft a sales battlecard.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Competitor Analysis
skills.description: Uses web research to identify five direct competitors for a product and profiles their strengths, weaknesses, pricing and go-to-market, ending with differentiation opportunities.
skills.author: Pawel Huryn

skills.name: Market Sizing
skills.description: Estimates TAM, SAM and SOM for a product using both top-down and bottom-up methods, with sources, growth projections and the key assumptions to validate.
skills.author: Pawel Huryn

skills.name: Competitive Analysis Matrix
skills.description: Compares three to five competitors in a feature matrix, pricing table and 2x2 positioning map, marking which conclusions are verified and which are inferred, with strategic recommendations.
skills.author: Product on Purpose

skills.name: Summarize Interview
skills.description: Summarises a customer interview transcript into a fixed template covering current solution, jobs to be done, satisfaction, insights and action items, and saves it as a markdown file.
skills.author: Pawel Huryn

skills.name: User Personas
skills.description: Builds three research-based user personas from survey data, interviews or other files, each with a main job to be done, pains, desired gains and one unexpected insight.
skills.author: Pawel Huryn

skills.name: Survey Analysis
skills.description: Analyses survey results with confidence labels tied to sample size, segment breakdowns, open-text themes and hypothesis status, and states what the data cannot show.
skills.author: Product on Purpose

skills.name: Draft Content
skills.description: Drafts blog posts, social posts, newsletters, landing pages, press releases and case studies in a chosen tone, with headline options and SEO suggestions. It drafts only and does not publish.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Email Sequence
skills.description: Plans and writes multi-email campaigns such as onboarding, nurture or win-back, with timing, branching and exit rules, a flow diagram and A/B test ideas. It drafts only and sends nothing.
skills.author: Anthropic

skills.name: Release Notes
skills.description: Rewrites tickets, PRDs or changelogs as plain-language release notes grouped into new features, improvements, fixes and breaking changes, and saves them as a markdown file.
skills.author: Pawel Huryn

skills.name: Copywriting
skills.description: Writes or edits website copy (homepage, landing, pricing, feature pages). It flags claims that lack evidence instead of inventing them and avoids common AI-sounding phrasing.
skills.author: Corey Haines

skills.name: Film Production
skills.description: Turns a plain description into a short film: plans the shots, makes keyframes for your approval, then renders the clips with image and video services you set up and edits them into one film.
skills.author: LibraOS
